summary: AMETEK filed an 8-K announcing completion of its previously announced acquisition of Indicor Instrumentation from Indicor, LLC, an all-cash transaction valued at $5.0 billion. The portfolio includes mission-critical instrumentation businesses for industrial and scientific applications, adding ~$350 million to 2026 sales and modestly accretive to adjusted earnings. The acquired businesses will join AMETEK's Electronic Instruments Group (EIG) and Electromechanical Group (EMG). No advisors or break fee were disclosed. Completion was announced on August 26, 2026. Watch for integration progress and potential synergies realization.
